The [[Kian'thar]] [[Kreet'ah]], a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]], had a '''daughter''' by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. As Kreet'ah's position with Black Sun was assured&mdash;[[Gender/Legends|he]] inherited his coveted Vigo title from his [[Shal'mak|mother]] and demonstrated due competence&mdash;his daughter would no doubt take Kreet'ah's place.
